denominator_definitions.static_category_field_opportunities: For every record, count every category-level frozen core field, including source-missing fields.
denominator_definitions.existing_core_facts: Frozen core fields that have a non-placeholder value in the same-product structured source.
denominator_definitions.formal_core_attribute_count: Per-sample count already frozen in the generation evaluation input and annotation; this alone is the attribute-hit denominator.
denominator_definitions.mandatory_injection_denominator: Only actual Mandatory facts produced after source presence and quality gates. Missing source fields are not expected Mandatory facts.
invariants: Static opportunities never replace formal core_attribute_count.
A source-missing core field is not a Mandatory injection failure.
RAG v2 does not modify attribute_checklist, core_attribute_count, matching rules, or the formal denominator.

train_summary.quality_rule_basis: General issue classes only; no product-specific allow or block patches.

general_rules.mandatory_candidate_fields: Exactly match configs/generation_evaluation.json core_attributes by category.
general_rules.identity: Category plus quality-eligible brand/model. Core brand/model also receive an identity coverage marker but are not duplicated in the Prompt.
general_rules.mandatory: Same-product frozen core field; source value present; quality_status eligible; one distinct normalized value; positive or neutral; suitable for active expression.
general_rules.negative: Eligible negative task facts are read-only constraints and are excluded from Mandatory and Supplemental.
general_rules.supplemental: Remaining eligible non-identity, non-Mandatory, non-Negative facts, ranked by the unchanged RRF and capped at three without padding.
general_rules.multivalue: Different normalized values require SKU resolution and are withheld from Mandatory and Supplemental.
general_rules.review: Withhold only audit-flagged fields. Unrelated eligible fields remain available.
general_rules.conflict: Identity/category conflict blocks the product; an ordinary field conflict blocks only that field.
general_rules.placeholder: Drop configured placeholders, all-placeholder composites, frozen category names used as model values, and negative/absence values used as brand or model.
general_rules.traceability: Every injected fact retains product_id, source field/value, source path/hash, audit status, quality reasons, and fact_id.

field_decisions.保温杯.适用人群: Specific values such as 儿童 or 学生 may be Mandatory; 大众 and generational marketing labels are Supplemental-only.
field_decisions.保温杯.适用场景: Specific values such as 运动、旅行、商用 may be Mandatory; 日常送礼 and 通用 are Supplemental-only.
field_decisions.收纳箱.适用对象: Single eligible value may be Mandatory; different multiple values are withheld.
field_decisions.收纳箱.适用空间: Single eligible value may be Mandatory; different multiple values are withheld.
field_decisions.收纳箱.净重: Mandatory only for a single positive parseable g/kg value; 0kg, placeholders, and malformed values are withheld.
field_decisions.垃圾桶.适用场景: 家庭使用 is generic and remains Supplemental-only rather than forced Mandatory coverage.

implementation_guards.paired_seed: V1-control, V2-context, and V2-coverage use base_seed + frozen_sample_index; variant name never affects seed.
implementation_guards.token_preflight: Render and tokenize without truncation. Verify every serialized Mandatory fact is present, reject length above max_input_tokens, and verify the exact token IDs passed to the model.
implementation_guards.mandatory_injection_failure: Any missing/truncated Mandatory fact is an error and cannot be counted as 100% injection completeness.
